passages.note: Bill overview lists Wilmeth as a co-sponsor of HB2853, signed into law as Chapter 388.

passages.provision_quote: Notwithstanding section 15-2401, beginning in the 2022-2023 school year, in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires, "qualified student" includes a resident of this state who both: 1. Is eligible to enroll in a public school in this state in any of the following: ( a ) A preschool program for children with disabilities. ( b ) A kindergarten program. ( c ) Any of grades one through twelve. 2. Does not otherwise qualify for an Arizona empowerment scholarship account pursuant to this chapter.
passages.note: The enacted text adds section 15-2401.01, expanding ESA eligibility to any student eligible to enroll in public school statewide, without the prior disability/failing-school/other qualifying criteria.
House Third Reading vote record shows Wilmeth voting Y on final passage of HB2853.

rows.reasoning: Wilmeth co-sponsored HB2853 (2022) and voted Y on its final House passage (31-26-3-0-0); the enacted law (Chapter 388) adds section 15-2401.01 making any student 'eligible to enroll in a public school in this state' in preschool, kindergarten or grades one through twelve qualify for an empowerment scholarship account, matching rung 5's 'universal vouchers so that education funding follows the student to any school — public, private, or religious — chosen by the family.'
